p7_b5.ocr: Notably, the columns titled "Pv-210" and "Pv-247" provide insight into the isotopic composition relevant to the spatial analysis of the topographic features represented. Such isotopic data are critical in environmental studies, where understanding the geological and hydrological characteristics of an area is essential for effective resource management and ecological assessments.

p7_b6.ocr: The inclusion of metrics such as "Variable" and "WHR" further enriches the dataset, allowing for nuanced interpretations of the topographic variations captured in the analysis. By systematically organizing these variables, the table serves as a valuable resource for researchers and practitioners seeking to leverage VTK for advanced modeling and visualization of topographic landscapes. The structured data empowers informed decision-making and facilitates deeper exploration of the underlying geospatial phenomena.
